dayToDay.notes: Guided wilderness backpacking, not a campus program — "curfew" and "leaving campus" don't apply the usual way. Staff-to-camper ratio is at least 2 staff per 10 youth, and campers are with their group essentially the entire trip, sleeping outdoors at group campsites. Very little unstructured time: days involve hiking, a structured daily morning meeting, evening group activities/campfire, and shared meals. No phone service in the backcountry and no planned parent contact during the trip — guides send a nightly satellite check-in to the office (not to parents), consistent with the program's explicit "no news is good news" policy. Parents get a recap email with photos 1–2 weeks after the trip ends.
dayToDay.sourceCitation: Lasting Adventures Yosemite summer camp FAQ pages (identical language across 6-Day Young Adventurer's, 6-Day High Country, and 10-Day Mammoth pages)
